DIAGNOSIS READY: Mantle Cell Lymphoma

The test results showing elevated WBC, low hemoglobin, and the presence of "smudge cells" on the peripheral smear are classic indicators of lymphoma, specifically Mantle Cell Lymphoma given your age and weight loss. The presence of smudge cells is a hallmark of this condition, which explains your fatigue and constitutional symptoms. I am not proceeding with a diagnosis of Cellulitis as that does not fit the laboratory evidence.

I will now request images of the bone marrow to confirm the diagnosis.
